name: Geenie
description:
Geenie connects your Amazon Advertising and Selling Partner (Seller Central) data to Claude, so you can run your whole Amazon business in plain English.

Ask and get real answers: campaign, keyword, product, and search-term performance across Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display; DSP metrics; sales, orders, inventory, fees, and Brand Analytics; competitive pricing, BSR, reviews, and listing details.

Then take action: create and manage campaigns, ad groups, and targets; adjust bids and budgets; harvest keywords and add negatives; update listings; and build AMC audiences — all through chat, with confirmation before any change.

Built for sellers and agencies: switch between brands, run multi-account reporting, and go deep with Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) and DSP — capabilities most tools don't expose. Read tools run instantly; write actions always confirm first.

Requires a Geenie account (geenie.io) with a connected Amazon Advertising and/or Seller Central account. Independent service, not affiliated with Amazon.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Geenie to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Geenie to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.geenie.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Geenie MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Geenie provides these MCP tools: geenie_connect, geenie_execute_read, geenie_execute_write, geenie_get_active_account, geenie_get_plan, geenie_list_accounts, geenie_search_tools, and geenie_switch_account.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Geenie?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Geenie in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Geenie requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Geenie is developed by Foxglove Brands. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
